exposure: pregnancy more than 12 months after bariatric surgery
early pregnancy (≤ 12 months after bariatric surgery)
cohort: Pregnant women who had undergone bariatric surgery
finding: Early pregnancy (≤ 12 months) after bariatric surgery was not associated with significant adverse maternal or perinatal outcomes, except for lower gestational weight gain.
mod_finding: The authors found no significant difference in rate of cesarean section between people who conceived less than 12 months after bariatric surgery and those who conceived later.
